title: Chromosome Architecture: Centromeres, Telomeres and Chromatids
method: Whitespace-delimited visible narrative excluding headings, tables, SVG, captions, questions, references and UI. Article count excludes SVG and buttons.
comparator: 2.B.10: 9074 narrative words, 21 sections; 2.B.06: 8518 narrative words, 17 sections. 2.C.08 is narrower, covering structural chromosome anatomy, function, morphology and measurements without duplicating the full cell-cycle, epigenetics or replication chapters.
scientific_checks: Official merged NET Unit 2.C p.3 and separate LS p.2 visually verified; MP SET 2024 archive p.2 visually verified. Reviewed Alberts textbook, Levan morphology convention, Clarke–Carbon 1980 and later budding yeast centromere review, de Lange shelterin and Blackburn–Greider–Szostak discovery account, human acrocentric NOR evidence and holocentric examples. Second review clarified CENP-A/kinetochore, arm ratio limits, telomere strand polarity, t-loop local displacement, chromosome/duplex counts, FISH and flow cytometry, exceptions and distractors. Arithmetic independently checked.
limitations: Static source checks and two editorial review passes by the same assistant, not independent human peer review; no interactive browser/device or rendered SVG audit. MP SET syllabus is a 2024 archive, not current official MPPSC-hosted copy. Pages verification pending. Unpublished immediate neighbors remain disabled.
